reviews.title: the worst company in the 'economy' class
reviews.text: The worst company ever. Today I was convinced of this for the last time. I thought I'd give a chance ... We fly every year, but when we have to deal with this kind of ‘airline’ it always ends in disgust.
reviews.author: Sergey K

reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.text: Nothing special, but flight was delayed for about 1/2 hour. Luckily I had booked hotel in Moscow for the night before catching early morning plane out of Moscow. Will be problematic if I had a tight connecting flight. No food served, no entertainment. Drinks were free, at least. Announcements in both Russian and English. Not many airlines fly out of Makhachkala, so choices are limited.
reviews.author: ShilohinBC

reviews.title: The service is great
reviews.text: I travelled from Moscow to Krasnoyarsk, the price is good, there was no tv, nor something to do, but the flight asistants are quitet nice, and the food is really nice
reviews.author: Juan S
